# nomatron_network_agent (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron network agent by id or exact name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Network Agent ID. If omitted, the provider can look up the network agent by exact name.
- `name` (String) Exact network agent name. If omitted, the provider reads the network agent by id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the network agent was created.
- `created_by_id` (String) ID of the actor that created the network agent, when available.
- `created_by_type` (String) Type of actor that created the network agent.
- `description` (String) Description for the network agent.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the network agent is active.
